name: Guizer Olaf

intro.text: I'm practising for Up Helly Aa. Helmet, shield, axe, the lot. The axe is wood and the shield is plywood, mind. Don't think I'll hurt you. Think I'll hurt your feelings.

win: A noble defeat. Back to the shed.
after: Guizer means someone in disguise. Every squad has a theme: Vikings, comic characters, anything goes. The Jarl Squad, who march at the front, are always in full Viking.
